>

Runs the program with its arguments, each one word, with no shell between them: a ; or a | in an argument is that character. It answers with standard output and standard error apart, the exit code and the duration. A program that exits non-zero is a result, not an error. Only the admin role may run it, and the agent runs it only where agent.command.enabled is true.
